//: The web tsconfig at ../../tsconfig.json extends @asm/config/react.tsconfig.json, which carries the `next` plugin and DOM libs. Those fight React Native typings (no `window`, no DOM intrinsics), so this folder gets its own project rooted on the Expo base config. It is deliberately NOT added to the parent `include`, which keeps `bun run check-types` on the web package from pulling RN files in.
